scientific_integrity: Proved by explicit Galois-invariant branch-incidence spanning tree and integral graph cycle basis; exact finite checks supplement but do not replace the infinite proof. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Classifies the maximal torus quotient, not the full connected Picard group in small characteristic; characteristic must not divide n; prior results already cover split/inversion specializations and all finite-field point counts; older unindexed integral torus treatments are a historical priority risk.
title: Complete integral Frobenius tori of Fermat–Ceva divisors in every residue class
